text: Energy reserves are low. Scanning for local energy sources... Detected.
The locals ignore these high-yield Iron Nodes.
Their ignorance is our gain. Harvest it.
We need power and resources. Now.
Commander, energy reserves are at critical levels.
The reactor alone cannot sustain expansion.
A Steam Generator will supplement our power grid.
Nothing runs without power. Get a generator online, priority one.
Commander, our Robotic Swarm reserves can be converted into specialized units.
The Builder Factory will repurpose swarm units into dedicated Builders for construction.
A Researcher Factory produces units for the Laboratory.
Raw swarms are wasted potential.
Get those factories running and specialize every last one of them.
Commander, our Researchers can develop new structural blueprints.
Given sufficient energy and time.
A Laboratory would enable this.
Engineering superiority is how we hold this ground. Build it.
Our reserves are capped at baseline capacity.
I recommend prioritizing storage infrastructure.
Resource Warehouses, Energy Batteries, and a Robot Bay.
Without expanded reserves, further expansion stalls.
A fortress without stockpiles is just a target. Research them all.
Long-range sensors are picking up movement beyond the perimeter.
I recommend stockpiling iron reserves and researching defensive wall structures.
Agreed. I want walls up before whatever is out there decides to pay us a visit."
Hostile biosignatures confirmed, approaching from the north.
Small patrol, six to eight contacts. They are not friendly, Commander.
Walls up, turrets online. This is our ground now. Prepare for engagement.
New contact.
A larger force is massing to the west.
Estimated twice the size of the previous engagement.
They are probing our flanks.
Reinforce the western perimeter, turrets and walls.
Nothing gets through.
Commander, I am detecting coordinated movement from multiple vectors.
North, west, and south simultaneously. This is not a random patrol.
A pincer maneuver. These things have actual military tactics.
Shore up every approach, spread our turrets across all fronts.
Recommend prioritizing resource production to sustain extended multi-front engagement.
Analysis complete.
Our terraforming emissions are directly provoking the indigenous population.
The more we reshape this environment, the more aggressively they resist.
The whole point is to reshape this environment.
We do not stop.
Push output, reinforce defenses and hold the line.
Understood. Monitoring terraforming levels.
Expect escalating hostility with each expansion cycle.
Commander, a massive biosignature is approaching from the north.
It dwarfs anything we have encountered. Designating it as a Warden-class entity.
That is a command unit. They sent their best.
All defenses to maximum, concentrate fire on the big one.
Warden is accompanied by a full assault wave.
Recommend eliminating the command unit first to break enemy cohesion.
